# Tank Metrics

> 101 free, instant business and money calculators for entrepreneurs, students and small business owners in India. Every tool runs in the browser, in rupees and crores, with no sign-up. The site also publishes plain-English guides and a news desk on Indian funding, Shark Tank deals and money rules.
